verdict.rationale: Name.com documents its own email forwarding capability through the API, which covers one half of the story. Nothing in the evidence mentions SSL certificates, and nothing shows that either feature is bundled at no extra cost. Missing for 10: any evidence of free SSL, evidence that email forwarding is included free with registration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the basics are bundled — email forwarding on my domain and free SSL so the parked-to-launched path costs nothing extra

citations.quote: Creates a new email forwarding rule for a domain, such as redirecting info@example.com to an external inbox.
